column_description: UUID PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each plant record (was 'RecordID') (e.g., '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6').
VARCHAR(100) naming or aliasing the plant (was 'PlantName') (e.g., 'DesertSolarOne', 'ValleyGridAlpha').
NUMERIC(7,3) indicating the generation capacity in megawatts (was 'PlantCapacityMW') (e.g., 12.500).
DATE representing the plant’s installation or commissioning date (was 'InstallationDate') (e.g., '2022-05-10').
